Fireplace interior trans-orange flame-glow pushing outward through an open cabin door, a hot amber-orange pool spreading onto the white-plate snow in a narrow wedge directly in front of the doorway.
Fireplace trans-orange glow bleeding through cabin window bricks, casting a warm amber rectangle onto the white-plate snow outside while the surrounding snow sits in deep cool-blue night shadow.

Fireplace interior light warming the cabin wall bricks to a deep trans-orange, a thin hot-amber spill leaking under the door seam and landing as a single bright line on the white-plate snow step below.

String-lights draped along chalet eaves sending multicolour trans-red, trans-yellow, and trans-green point-glow downward, each bulb stamping a small warm-coloured disc onto the white-plate snow directly below it.

String-lights looped between two pine trees overhead, multicolour bulbs casting alternating warm-amber and cool-blue-green pools onto the white-plate snow below, each pool overlapping slightly with its neighbour.
String-lights running along a fence-top, trans-yellow and trans-orange bulbs pushing downward warm small halos onto the white-plate snow at the fence base, deep unlit-blue snow between each bulb gap.

Candle lantern at mid-left, warm trans-yellow point-light pushing a hot amber pool directly beneath itself onto the white-plate snow, deep-blue shadow spreading outward in every direction beyond the lantern's reach.
Candle inside a trans-clear window lantern on a post, warm trans-yellow glow pushing downward onto the white-plate snow in a tight hot circle, inky-blue shadow beginning sharply at the circle's edge.

Lantern mounted on a cabin corner, warm trans-orange point-source pushing light diagonally right-downward onto the white-plate snow, one bright amber pool at the lantern base fading to cool blue within two studs.

Blizzard white-out condition with featureless white-grey wash from all directions, white-plate snow indistinguishable from sky baseplate, no shadow, no highlight, every brick edge lost in the uniform pale diffuse field.

Blizzard white-out pressing flat white-grey light from every angle simultaneously, white-plate snow reading as pure neutral-white with zero shadow or depth, fence posts and pine trees barely separating from the snowfield.

Blizzard white-out featureless cool-white ambient erasing all directional light, white-plate snow and sky-brick sharing the same pale tone, the scene reduced to flat white with only dark brick outlines visible.

Ice-cave trans-cyan refracted glow from within the cave baseplate below-left, cool blue-cyan ambient light pushing upward and outward onto the white-plate snow at the cave mouth in a cold glowing pool.

Ice-cave trans-cyan glow bouncing off interior ice-brick walls and pushing outward from the cave entrance, pale cyan-blue ambient washing the white-plate snow at the threshold with a cold electric-blue tint.

Snow-fall evening with a single street-lamp pushing trans-yellow downward, warm amber halo forming on the white-plate snow below the lamp-head, each falling-snow plate catching a brief warm-yellow glint within the halo.

Snow-fall evening street-lamp from directly above, trans-yellow warm cone of light surrounding the post, the white-plate snow below registering a tight warm-amber disc while falling-snow elements glow yellow within the beam.

Ski-lift flood at base-station, cool overhead white flood pushing straight down from the lift-tower bracket, white-plate snow below reading as harsh pale-grey with short dark-blue shadows directly beneath every brick stud.

Ski-lift base-station flood from directly overhead, cool blue-white light washing the white-plate snow in a flat harsh pale tone, deep-blue shadow pockets sitting tight under every fence-brick base and cable-tower foot.

Eclipse shadow rolling in from the left, deep-purple ambient replacing all warm light, the white-plate snowfield turning to dark cool-grey with faint residual red-amber only at the very right edge of the baseplate.

Bonfire winter-solstice glow from a central fire-brick cluster, trans-orange and trans-yellow light radiating outward in all directions, warm amber pools surrounding the fire base and fading to cool-blue shadow at the snowfield perimeter.

Frozen-lake-cracking trans-white flash from below the ice-plate surface, an intense white-blue burst pushing upward through the translucent ice tiles and scattering cold white-blue ambient onto the surrounding white-plate snow edges.

Golden alpine-sunset raking low from the right, warm amber light gilding chalet rooftops and snow-cap tiles, long cool-blue plastic shadows stretching hard left across the white-plate snowfield below.
